status: validated measurement; interpretation and limits in directory-review-validation.md
summaryPolicy: Independent batches only, no pooled medians or pooled p95. p95 is descriptive nearest-rank, not a confidence bound. Noise includes observed A1/A2 difference and the span of all four A batches, not an acceptance budget. Paired differences are B1-A3 and B2-A4.
methodology: Trusted event.timeStamp on common window capture; first matching DOM observed by mutation/scroll/event microtasks; two rAF proxy separately. Old listener-phase/rAF-polling comparison withdrawn. Common paths normalize geometry/open groups/hash; candidate-only manual resume has no equivalent old contract.
